items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: Well I used to like to listen to Clarence Gabriel, Lil Willie, Fat Bichon.

ctx.x: Did you have any particular piano player that you used to listen to a lot?

Well I used to like to listen to Clarence Gabriel, Lil Willie, Fat Bichon. Which Lil Willie is that? There was a piano player by the name of Lil Willie. He was a house party piano player. He could play the piano.
Did you see the guy that got killed a couple of Mardi Gras ago? I think it was?
